mapper.sql: select record_id, record_no, record_type, business_category, target_type, target_id, target_name, class_id, class_name, grade, subject, kit_id, kit_name, total_quantity, image_url, operator, operate_time, status, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from edu_material_record
mapper.select:
and del_flag = '0' and record_no like concat('%', #{recordNo}, '%') and record_type = #{recordType} and business_category like concat('%', #{businessCategory}, '%') and target_type = #{targetType} and target_name like concat('%', #{targetName}, '%') and class_name like concat('%', #{className}, '%') and grade = #{grade} and subject like concat('%', #{subject}, '%') and operator like concat('%', #{operator}, '%')
and date_format(operate_time,'%y%m%d') >= date_format(#{params.beginTime},'%y%m%d')
and date_format(operate_time,'%y%m%d') <= date_format(#{params.endTime},'%y%m%d')
order by operate_time desc, record_id desc
mapper.insert:
insert into edu_material_record
record_no, record_type, business_category, target_type, target_id, target_name, class_id, class_name, grade, subject, kit_id, kit_name, total_quantity, image_url, operator, operate_time, status, del_flag, create_by, create_time, remark,
#{recordNo}, #{recordType}, #{businessCategory}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{targetName}, #{classId}, #{className}, #{grade}, #{subject}, #{kitId}, #{kitName}, #{totalQuantity}, #{imageUrl}, #{operator}, #{operateTime}, #{status}, #{delFlag}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{remark},
mapper.select: select coalesce(sum(case when record_type = '1' and date(operate_time) = curdate() then 1 else 0 end), 0) as todayGrantCount, coalesce(sum(case when record_type = '1' and date(operate_time) = curdate() then total_quantity else 0 end), 0) as todayGrantQuantity, coalesce(sum(case when record_type = '2' and date(operate_time) = curdate() then 1 else 0 end), 0) as todayReturnCount, coalesce(sum(case when record_type = '2' and date(operate_time) = curdate() then total_quantity else 0 end), 0) as todayReturnQuantity, coalesce(count(distinct case when record_type = '1' and target_type = '1' then target_name end), 0) as totalTeacherCount, coalesce(count(distinct case when record_type = '1' and target_type = '2' then target_name end), 0) as totalStudentCount, coalesce(sum(case when record_type = '1' then total_quantity else 0 end), 0) as grandTotalGrantQty, coalesce(sum(case when record_type = '2' then total_quantity else 0 end), 0) as grandTotalReturnQty from edu_material_record where del_flag = '0' and status = '0'
